{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter to completed orders only
completed = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']
print(f'Number of completed orders: {len(completed)}')

# Check revenue format
print('\nSample of revenue values:')
print(completed['revenue'].head(10))

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast
completed['revenue_float'] = completed['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders (we saw earlier there are none, but verify)
qa_mask = completed['revenue_float'] == 999999.99
print(f'QA orders found in completed set: {qa_mask.sum()}')

# Now compute mean revenue of completed orders
mean_revenue = completed['revenue_float'].mean()
print(f'\nMean revenue of completed orders: {mean_revenue:.2f}')"}
